name: @camelia/desktop
description: Camelia desktop shell (Tauri 2.x) — wraps @camelia/ui as a native Windows app.

scripts.desktop:build: pnpm --filter @camelia/ui build && cargo build --release --features custom-protocol --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.desktop:bundle: pnpm --filter @camelia/ui build && cargo tauri build --features custom-protocol --bundles nsis
